Story

From Tadian School of Arts and Trades to BS Computer Science.

My love for technology began at Tadian School of Arts and Trades, where I studied Computer Systems Servicing and learned the basics of computers, hardware, and troubleshooting. Today I’m a BS Computer Science student at the University of the Cordilleras, building on that hands-on foundation.

Goals

Sharpen my skills and build tools that matter.

My mission is to sharpen my technical skills, explore software and logic design, and build practical tools that make everyday tasks easier.
